script_text: Taurus, Venus your ruling planet activates your seventh house of partnerships this week. Monday opens with the Moon in your third house squaring Mars in your twelfth, your worst day to talk; avoid tense talks. Tuesday brings Venus in your fifth house trine Uranus in your first, sparking sudden romance and creative risk, so it's your best day. Wednesday, Mercury in your sixth opposes Neptune in your eleventh, clouding career contracts; double-check everything. The mid-week turning point hits Thursday when the Sun conjuncts Mars in your seventh, sparking passion and partner power struggles. Friday through Sunday, Venus enters your seventh as the Moon hits your first, softening your aura for intimate weekend reconnection. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines your natal Uranus. Monday is your danger day due to the Mars square. Carry emerald green to ground your earth energy. Follow for daily updates.
